change: Fixed a bug where relaunching a locally built developer copy of the app could silently revert the AI Provider setting from Local back to Omi's cloud service, causing chat and voice replies to be refused with a billing message even though Local was correctly configured; a locally selected AI Provider is now preserved across rebuilds. Also improved the error shown when voice transcription is refused for being over your plan's limit: it now says so directly instead of showing a generic voice-reply failure. The Local provider now reads the model's actual context length from the server, so follow-up questions no longer come back blank once the conversation grows, and an out-of-budget reply is reported as an error instead of an empty message.
